attributes.description: Roster inventory of GitHub organization members: roles, MFA status, team memberships, and account metadata.

params.markdown:
This dashboard provides a roster inventory of all members in the GitHub organization.

It shows member counts by role, MFA enrollment status, team memberships, and privilege concentration (which members administer the most teams).

**MFA panels require the Collect MFA Status option** to be enabled in the integration configuration, plus an `admin:org`-scoped Classic PAT held by an org owner. Without these conditions the `has_two_factor_enabled` field is absent and MFA panels display zero.

[**Integrations Page**](/app/integrations/detail/github/overview)
